CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content is asserted.

COD.rationale: Content (color at coordinates), presentation (coordinate listing) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly given for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition tied to a content's presentation or access is stated.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names contents (color labels) bound to coordinates.

D.rationale: Origin/status metadata is separately reported alongside identified content entries.

O.rationale: The text specifies how content is presented (coordinate listings) and the grid orientation.
